collection.title: Volkswagen Multivan T6 2015 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW MultivanT6 2015 to 2022 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this Multivan, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
